capabilities: render Markdown tables as interactive editable database views
switch tables to a Kanban board grouped by a status column
add colored single-select and multi-select tags and date pickers to cells
filter, sort and search table rows
export tables as CSV or clean printed PDF
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README emphasizes zero lock-in and that tables stay valid Markdown if the plugin is disabled.
intentEvidence: with 100% plain Markdown and zero vendor lock-in
motivation: Keeps all data as plain GitHub-Flavored Markdown tables so nothing is locked in if the plugin is removed.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown tables are static text, so users who want Notion-style interactive views must leave their data in a proprietary format or separate app.

relations.evidence: Transform standard Markdown tables into interactive Notion-like databases and Kanban boards

summary: Renders standard Markdown tables as interactive Notion-like databases with Kanban boards, colored tags, date pickers, filters and summary calculations.
